reviewed_contract: PoseSource preserves Clip, SphericalPair and Weighted interpolation semantics; grouped weighted averaging never silently substitutes for an inner spherical pair.
Outer interpolation applies shortest-arc SLERP to finished local rotations, linear interpolation to finished local translation/scale, then composes hierarchy and skin palettes once.
Both sources and outer weights validate before selection, including inactive endpoints, zero-weight invalid samples, count limits and finite numeric bounds.
Exact outer endpoints reuse the respective source sampler without an additional blend, matching existing sample/sample_blend/sample_weighted results.

Weighted scratch uses unpublished local matrices; group_trs retains the completed outgoing TRS separately while incoming weighted sampling reuses staging. One publish swaps live pose only after all composed matrices/palettes pass.
Failure after a scratch swap leaves only private scratch modified. Subsequent samplers initialize from retained rest, so no incomplete scratch reaches a later publication.

One additional rest-sized Vec<Option<NodeTrs>> is allocated at player construction; retained_bytes increases the per-node scratch charge from two to three arrays, with checked aggregate arithmetic. Existing data/palette/topology charges remain.

New tests use an independent numerical non-flattening angle/skin-position oracle, all source-pair endpoints, linear/static-node behavior, invalid inactive inputs and composition-overflow recovery in both source directions.

1024 accepted mixed updates are measured allocation-free; diagnostic allocation on rejected input is explicitly outside that promise. Existing published API uses allocated AssetError::Invalid strings.
method: Read all seven frozen source/test files, surrounding sampling/publication/validation code, and hash-verified producer logs; no source mutations, new compilation, GPU or native window execution.
limitations: CPU interpolation primitive only; no authored graph/cooked/runtime/save/SDK/rendered fade connection accepted by this receipt.
The primitive admits at most16 contributions per input (up to32 total); the future graph layer must enforce its own tighter combined bound.
No independent fresh test execution; this receipt verifies supplied terminal logs and source.
No device/performance/phase gate; allocation claim applies to accepted sampling, not allocated error diagnostics.
